title: Build target-owned A2A domain reply worker
intent: Close the post-handler A2A semantic-reply gap without fake peer authorship. The current system proves Hermes M5 handler delivery through the inbox bridge and proves NO_REPLY through reply capture. Build or specify the smallest target-owned mechanism that can emit a typed dharma.a2a.domain_receipt.v1 payload to the sender's recorded reply_subject, so scripts/runtime/a2a_reply_capture.py can honestly record DOMAIN_RECEIPTED when a real target runtime participates.
acceptance: No Codex-authored file or payload is represented as a Hermes, Fable, Devin, or other peer semantic reply.
The design requires target-owned handling before a reply can be treated as semantic collaboration.
A typed domain receipt payload uses schema_version dharma.a2a.domain_receipt.v1 or another schema accepted by scripts/runtime/a2a_reply_capture.py as a domain receipt.
scripts/runtime/a2a_reply_capture.py records DOMAIN_RECEIPTED only after reading a payload from the recorded reply_subject.
If no target runtime is available, the run records NO_REPLY or a command-proven blocker instead of claiming success.
The NATS substrate contract names the ownership boundary between delivery-handler ack and semantic/domain reply.
Focused tests cover no-reply, untyped reply, and typed domain receipt classification.

commit.message: feat(a2a): add target-owned domain reply worker
